roles.name: Digital Specialist Engineer

minSolvedThreshold.description: 1 Problem Full (P1: 20 marks) + at least 30-40% test cases on P2 (10-15 marks) for a total of ~30-35 marks.

ladderTiers: P1 Easy (Arrays, Strings, Prefix Sums, Two Pointers)
P2 Medium (Greedy, Sorting, Binary Search Basics)
roles.description: Entry-tier digital development role focused on application engineering, clean coding, and core algorithmic problem solving.

roles.name: Specialist Programmer (L1)

minSolvedThreshold.description: 2 Problems Full (P1 + P2 = 50 marks) or P1 Full + high partial passes on both P2 and P3 (~55-60 marks).

ladderTiers: P2 Medium Mastery (Binary Search on Answer, Monotonic Stack, Sliding Window)
roles.description: Primary high-paying development track at Infosys, requiring clean multi-pointer techniques, greedy proofs, and basic DP proficiency.

roles.name: Specialist Programmer (L2)

minSolvedThreshold.description: 2 Problems Full (P1 + P2 = 50 marks) + > 60-70% hidden test cases on P3 (30-35 marks) for a total of ~80-85 marks.

ladderTiers: P3 Hard (2D Dynamic Programming, Knapsack, State-Machine DP, Tree DFS)
Advanced Graph Traversals (Dijkstra, DSU, BFS with Bitmask State)
roles.description: Advanced technical tier demanding optimization under tight constraints, zero TLE solutions, and comprehensive edge-case handling.

roles.name: Specialist Programmer (L3)

minSolvedThreshold.description: All 3 Problems Fully Solved (100/100 marks) with optimal asymptotic bounds, plus stellar performance in the rapid pre-interview coding round.

ladderTiers: Advanced Bitmask DP, Segment Trees, Coordinate Compression, Linear Basis
roles.description: Top fresher compensation tier reserved for national finalist caliber candidates capable of 100% test case clearance on LeetCode Hard / Codeforces 1700-2000 problems.
